Windows Presentation Foundation Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Windows Presentation Foundation Developer for a contract opportunity in Hillsboro, OR.
 
 
 Windows Presentation Foundation Developer Job Details 
 

 Focus on developing and maintaining application central to Intel's global revenue forecasting processes. 
 Developers will be involved in reviewing current state design and working with the technical lead to define future state design, document, review, develop, test, and implement product. 
 
 
 Windows Presentation Foundation Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 -High proficiency with Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) 
 -Microsoft Visual Studio (2012+ required), C#, .NET 4/4.5 
 -Entity Framework, and unit testing. 
  
 Windows Presentation Foundation Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 Windows Presentation Foundation Developer Assignment Length 
 

 10 months


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
